title: MCA Reiterates Caution Against Unauthorised SMS Referencing 'MCA Signals'
content:
# MCA Reiterates Caution Against Unauthorised SMS Referencing 'MCA Signals'

Ek important update hai stakeholders ke liye. Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) ne haal hi mein phir se stakeholders ko unauthorised SMS messages, jismein "MCA Signals" ka zikr ho sakta hai, ke khilaaf caution kiya hai. Fraudsters aise messages bhej kar logon ko mislead karne ki koshish kar rahe hain.

*   **What's Happening:** MCA ne observe kiya hai ki cyber fraudsters Ministry ke naam par fraudulent calls, WhatsApp messages, emails, aur SMS circulate kar rahe hain. Kuch cases mein, yeh messages "MCA Signals" ya similar terms ka reference de sakte hain, jisse yeh lage ki woh official communication hai.
*   **MCA's Stance:** Ministry ne clearly stated kiya hai ki woh compliance issues, enforcement actions, ya regulatory proceedings ke regarding stakeholders se mobile calls ya WhatsApp messages ke through contact nahin karta hai. Official communications sirf authorised channels, primarily MCA website, ke through hi hoti hain.
*   **Why the Caution:** Aise fraudulent communications ka aim sensitive information nikalna, phishing attempts karna, ya stakeholders ko galat actions lene ke liye prompt karna hota hai.
*   **Advice to Stakeholders:**
    *   Suspicious links par click na karein.
    *   Unsolicited attachments ya ZIP files open na karein.
    *   Passwords, OTPs, bank details, ya other confidential information unverified sources ke saath share na karein.
    *   Always verify the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from MCA through their official website, `www.mca.gov.in`.

MCA sabhi stakeholders, including companies, directors, aur professionals ko cyber threats se vigilant rehne ki salah deta hai.
